architecture.mechanism: Coherence estimators detect voltage and current unbalances that degrade machine efficiency and accelerate wear
architecture.intervention: Implement the fifteen-coefficient coherence estimator algorithm on the motor terminal measurements to identify transient or structural magnetic asymmetries (e.g., eccentricity, loose core) that standard resistance checks miss
architecture.expected_effect: Identify the precise source of core loss or circulating current causing no-load heating, enabling targeted mechanical correction
architecture.falsification_test: If the coherence coefficients remain symmetric and stable over the 20-minute no-load interval while thermal overload still triggers, the mechanism of unbalance-driven heating is disproven
